groups.activity: Survival, Dark Sector, the five that start the chain

skip.reason: The chain is already unlocked, so nothing starts it

conditions: Do this trip before anything else. Five samples start a 360h serial timer, and every other step waits on it
Fieldron Samples are untradeable and unbuyable, so a clanmate cannot hand them over
Stage one also takes 100 Rubedo, 500 Nano Spores and 200 Polymer Bundle from the dojo vault
bonuses: Samples drop across all Corpus territory: Venus, Phobos, Jupiter, Europa, Neptune and Pluto

disclosures.title: no drop rate exists
disclosures.body: The wiki lists no mission or enemy drop table for Fieldron Sample, so there is no rate to plan against. Kelashin, Wahiba and Kadesh are the wiki's own suggested nodes, not measured ones.

skip.reason: Energy Lab chain finished years ago in an established clan

conditions: Strictly serial: each stage unlocks the next, so nothing here overlaps and the whole chain is 15 days from an empty lab
The Energy Lab room must already be built; the wiki does not publish its construction cost
Ghost-clan figures. A Moon clan pays up to x100 on every research resource below
In an established clan this whole group is already done and the plan starts at the dojo console
bonuses: The chain hands you Prova, Dera and Lanka along the way, all mastery you would otherwise skip

disclosures.title: what each stage consumes
disclosures.body: Fieldron: 5 Fieldron Sample, 100 Rubedo, 500 Nano Spores, 200 Polymer Bundle. Prova: 5 Fieldron Sample, 100 Rubedo, 500 Nano Spores, 200 Polymer Bundle. Dera: 5 Fieldron Sample, 200 Circuits, 500 Nano Spores, 250 Polymer Bundle. Lanka: 10 Fieldron Sample, 500 Ferrite, 250 Plastids, 500 Polymer Bundle. Helios: 7 Fieldron Sample, 100 Oxium, 750 Ferrite, 350 Nano Spores.

groups.activity: Survival, Dark Sector, the bulk Fieldron run

bonuses: Up to ~3,000 a run here, which is the fastest Salvage node on the list

rows.label: Oxium
rows.alt: or Cetus / Fortuna bounty stages 1-2, 100-200 a stage

conditions: Oxium Ospreys have to be killed by a player; the ones that self-destruct drop nothing

bonuses: Void drops these more often than Neptune or Europa

skip.reason: Feeds the finished Fieldron and Prova research only
Feeds the finished Dera research only

conditions: The blueprint comes from the Energy Lab, so this waits on the Fieldron research finishing, not on the whole chain
bonuses: Foundry builds run in parallel: all ten finish in one 12h window if the inputs are in hand
Rare and reinforced Corpus storage containers and Orb Vallis tier-4 bounties drop finished Fieldron, which cuts the count

disclosures.title: why ten Fieldron is the real cost
disclosures.body: Each craft is 15,000 credits, 10 Fieldron Sample, 1 Control Module, 500 Salvage and 250 Plastids. Ten of them is 150,000 credits, 100 Fieldron Sample, 10 Control Modules, 5,000 Salvage and 2,500 Plastids. That is the Helios grind; the sentinel itself is cheap.

rows.label: Helios Blueprint
rows.note: cheapest sentinel blueprint in the dojo

conditions: Helios research has to be finished, which is the tail end of the 360h chain
Cephalon Simaris does not sell this. He sells Detect Vulnerability, the Helios precept mod, for 75,000 standing

rows.label: Helios
rows.alt: or 75 p built from the Market

conditions: Two companion slots go at claim time, one for Helios and one for the bundled Deconstructor. A single free slot is not enough
A Forma you build costs 35,000 credits, 1 Morphics, 1 Neural Sensors, 1 Neurodes, 1 Orokin Cell and 23h, so budget it before starting
bonuses: Ships with the Deconstructor, a sentinel weapon usable only by Helios and Helios Prime
75 p for a built Helios skips the entire chain and is cheaper than rushing any part of it

disclosures.title: Helios Prime is a different item
disclosures.body: Helios Prime is relic-farmed. None of this research progresses it.
